'''Vuma''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Vuma system/Legends|Vuma system]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

The [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] gang from [[Mamendin]] called the "[[Slams]]" stole its planetary treasury in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]].
